notes.title: Oculus Rift Compatibility
notes.notes:
Heya!

Entropic Shop VR is now available for the Oculus Rift! Grab your copy and have fun into the Entropic Shop!

notes.title: Try Heist Dance for free - Entropic Shop VR DEMO
notes.notes:
Hey!

Here is a demo of Entropic Shop VR, allowing you to play to the minigame "Heist Dance" for free! Come and try it! Then get access to the full game, the leaderboards and the achievements by purchasing Entropic Shop VR.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?time_continue=2&v=fKhc6GifsXQ

Get the demo now !

notes.title: Heist Dance, new minigame available!
notes.notes:
Welcome players!

notes.title: A NEW MINI-GAME?!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Something weird is happening into the shop...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31718348/c83d09426c324776f73ad13bb15850dede497387.png[/img]

 A strange portal has appeared and we can hear music coming through... What does it want ?! Is it an other spell to steal our cash?! Well, we are preparing some "runic tools" to help you to defend the shop, just in case... Stay tuned!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31718348/c6b8645cfaf1a4f87fd1ca43beaa99e4c255bd81.png[/img]

notes.title: Steam Laderboard V2
notes.notes:
Hey guys !

We have implemented the steam leaderboard in game ! It now replaces the old scoreboard. You can also see the leaderboard in the Community Hub of Entropic Shop ;)

One of our developers still hold the high score !

I'm pretty sure you can't beat him ;)

notes.title: Steam Leaderboards and achievements are live!
notes.notes:
The first update for Entropic Shop VR is now available! We've added 9 achievements, 3 per mini-game! We plan to add harder achievements in the future but we first want to see how good you are so go unlock them! ;)

We've also added a leaderboard per mini-game, so you can compete for the best score with players all around the world! The leaderboards are only showing up on Steam for now but we are working on an in-game leaderboard integration!

We are waiting for some challengers right now. Can you beat the Big Horn team?

notes.title: Features coming in the next updates
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31718348/a763af4dc601b4c6175de2513386228b8ea328b1.png[/img]

Hello shop keepers!

It's been two weeks since the Early Access launch and it's probably time to tell you about what's going on, what we're working on and what will be next. But first, I would like to thank you for your feedback, your ideas and your support. You're awesome!

During the last two weeks, we spent most of our time patching some bugs and trying to improve the performances a little. The patch should go live next week.

Now, our priority is to add Steam achievements and leader board as this is the most requested feature. This will allow you to compete for the high score with other people from all around the world, while adding some objectives to the game.

We've also started to port the game for Occulus Touch, and we're working on two new mini games. We'll keep you updated on that.

Have a nice day!
